scope: WP10 worker-protected tamper-evident Isolation lifecycle audit archive
Fixed-high-water read-only snapshot from Isolation ledger schema 6
Operator CLI, package API, archive verifier and wire v1 compatibility

supportedBoundary.format: canonical content-addressed hash-linked NDJSON archive wire v1
supportedBoundary.protection: worker-protected and tamper-evident relative to a trusted digest

implementation: A dedicated readOnly SQLite connection uses query_only and one explicit BEGIN transaction to freeze schema, sequence high-water, source prefix and new rows.
Each content-addressed batch binds archive instance, canonical state-root digest, sequence range, snapshot high-water, previous batch digest and exact record bytes.
A private control SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE serializes exporters; all fd-closing control-file validation happens before lock acquisition and locked checks use lstat only.
Private temporary files use O_EXCL and O_NOFOLLOW, file fsync, atomic no-overwrite hardlink publication, temporary unlink and directory fsync; exact link-before-unlink crash residue is recovered.

The public verifier rejects uninitialized, control-only and incomplete archives, unknown entries or versions, noncanonical JSON, digest mismatch, fork, gap, duplicate, reorder, truncation and unsafe ownership or links.
archive-audit and verify-audit are operator-only CLI commands and both APIs are exported from the package root; no model tool receives the state or archive root.

limitations: The archive is protected from the isolated worker, not from a malicious or compromised same-UID Host or root.
SHA-256 linkage is not a signature and does not establish authenticity, nonrepudiation or WORM semantics.
Local verification cannot detect whole-chain replacement or rollback at a completed snapshot boundary without a protected external monotonic anchor.
The wire binds the canonical state-root path, not a persistent ledger instance ID; trusted replacement of a ledger at the same path is in the Host trust boundary.
A live-WAL read-only snapshot does not change schema or business rows but may create or use SQLite WAL or SHM coordination sidecars.
This slice preserves every SQLite audit row and does not solve state-root hard capacity, secure deletion, daemon-generation final reconciliation, version rollback or irreversible-action compensation.
failedChecks: Initial package test assumed an always-present WAL file; the assertion was corrected to the logical read-only contract while retaining main database and table equality.
Initial concurrent CLI assertion exposed that createdRecords counted replayed rows; accounting now counts only newly published content.
Independent four-process review exposed that closing another fd for the control inode released the POSIX SQLite lock; all fd validation moved before BEGIN IMMEDIATE and deterministic races now pass.
Independent schema review found valid audit detail above 16384 characters was rejected; detail now has its own bounded UTF-8 byte rule and a real large-record regression.
